name_reason: Name follows convention data_fd2_battle_<descriptor> for a battle-core scratch global. Descriptor 'ai_best_physical_target_x' accurately reflects use: the enemy-AI physical-attack scorer's best candidate target tile X coordinate. The '_x' suffix is a coordinate axis (semantic), NOT a Ghidra address residue (no _c43/_53c43). Ghidra primary symbol byte-identical to src name.
purpose: Enemy-AI physical-attack scratch slot holding the best-scoring candidate's target tile X coordinate; written by the scorer and read by the executor to walk the attacker to the chosen tile.
logic_summary: fd2_ai_score_physical_attack floods reachable tiles, evaluates each AoE target, and when a candidate beats the running best score writes candidate_x here (MOV [0x53C43],EAX @0x144DD) together with target_y/idx/score. fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack reads it (PUSH dword [0x53C43] @0x154C0) and passes it to fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile to move the attacker before the attack animation. Value is a byte tile coordinate zero-extended into a dword slot. First member of the ai_best_physical_* result group (X @0x53C43, Y @0x53C47, idx @0x53C4B, score @0x53C4F).
element_semantics: Single unsigned tile X coordinate (battle map column) of the AI's chosen physical-attack destination tile. Byte value zero-extended into the 4-byte slot; stored/loaded as a full dword.
notes: Verified writer/reader against disassembly: bytes @0x144DD = A3 43 3C 05 00 (MOV [0x53C43],EAX); reader @0x154C0 = PUSH dword [0x53C43] then CALL fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile (0x14B78). is_const=false because there is a game-side writer (0x144DD). Ghidra data plate was empty (get_plate_comment returns 'No function' for data; verified <none> via run_script_inline); created a concise plate via cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,..) consistent with sibling AI-scratch globals (0x53C23/0x53C3F already carry plates). src comment block (btl_aisc.c) already accurate+precise -> kept unchanged; src file not modified.
